name: receipt-backed-dynamics-v1
primary_metric: MAE of next queue/delivered on all held-out transitions; unknown uses an explicitly reported public-midpoint evaluation fallback
split: Distinct seeds, episode IDs, run IDs and receipts; frozen learned models never fit evaluation observations
existing_baseline: InformationForecast with default no_probe planner, receipt-validated past of the held-out episode only (online, latest 12)
untrained_baseline: Engine returns unknown; public midpoint service=2 is a separate scoring fallback, not a learned prediction
scope: Prediction learning, not improved decisions; low-service training intentionally tests stationarity failure after shift; no neural/stochastic fitting
